body:
This release addresses the following false positives, crashes, and compatibility issues:

- [SA4023](https://staticcheck.dev/docs/checks/#SA4023) more accurately tracks the nilness of interface values across branches and when loading global variables, fixing further false positives introduced with 2026.2 ([issue 1737](https://staticcheck.dev/issues/1737), [issue 1738](https://staticcheck.dev/issues/1738)). Furthermore, it no longer assumes that zero values of unconstrained type parameters are always nil.
- [SA4023](https://staticcheck.dev/docs/checks/#SA4023) no longer crashes when checking calls to functions from indirect dependencies ([issue 1741](https://staticcheck.dev/issues/1741)).
- [SA1019](https://staticcheck.dev/docs/checks/#SA1019) no longer crashes on composite literals of generic structs that set deprecated fields ([issue 1821](https://staticcheck.dev/issues/1821)).
- A crash when comparing values of type parameters with their zero values using ordering comparisons such as <= has been fixed.
- Staticcheck now supports the updated export data format used by Go 1.27.2.
- Several bugs in the intermediate representation involving generic methods, closures in methods of generic types, and nil unsafe.Pointer values have been fixed.
- The intermediate representation now correctly distinguishes goto from continue when jumping to a label on a range-over-func loop. Furthermore, it preserves the correct evaluation order for receive assignments in single-case select statements.

Furthermore, this release reduces memory usage and avoids unnecessary work when building the intermediate representation, particularly when handling methods and generic types.
